notes.title: Oculus 1.3 Support & HTC Vive support
notes.notes:
Hello reader,

Just to clarify, for anyone who has the game currently or is interested in purchasing; we're supporting Oculus CV1 & DK2 as well as HTC Vive all within this one Steam item. When we launched: the Oculus version running with current runtime was unable to boot. Thanks to a player's report, however, it's been fixed & we're rolling on all these platforms! Thanks very much to everyone who has supported us out of the gate, & I hope you're all enjoying Ruckus Ridge!

-Jacob
